sections.number: Requirements specific to class 2 and 3.1 substances
sections.title: Requirements specific to class 2 and 3.1 substances

sections.number: 1 Class 2 and 3.1 substances to be secured
sections.title: Class 2 and 3.1 substances to be secured

items.action: Determine whether the substances must be secured Verify that the requirements relating to security are met
items.records: A record of the quantities present, as compared to the threshold quantities A record of the means by which the substances are secured

sections.number: 2 Class 2 and 3.1 substances to be segregated from incompatible substances
sections.title: Class 2 and 3.1 substances to be segregated from incompatible substances

items.action: Verify that incompatible substances are segregated
items.records: A record identifying the incompatible substances and the means of segregation

sections.number: 3 Hazardous areas for class 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 3.1A, 3.1B, or 3.1.C substances
sections.title: Hazardous areas for class 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 3.1A, 3.1B, or 3.1.C substances

items.action: Verify whether the hazardous area is delineated in accordance with AS/NZS 60079.10.1:2009
items.records: A note as to whether the hazardous area is compliant

items.action: Verify that— (a) the hazardous substances are not in contact with incompatible substances; and (b) containers of incompatible substances are stored separately
items.records: Verify that the hazardous area is delineated, classified, and depicted on a site plan Verify sample elements of the plan to ensure it is correct

items.action: Verify that the hazardous area is maintained
items.records: A reference to the electrical dossier A copy (or date and identifier) of electrical certificate(s) A note or record of representative samples of procedures and/or equipment

sections.number: 4 Separation of class 2.1.1 permanent gases
sections.title: Separation of class 2.1.1 permanent gases

items.action: Verify that the prescribed separation distance between the vehicle fill points and storage of permanent gas is met
items.records: A record that confirms the minimum distance is complied with

items.action: Verify that the prescribed separation distances are met
items.records: A record that confirms the minimum distances are complied with

items.action: Verify that the prescribed separation distances are met
items.records: A record that confirms the minimum distances are complied with

sections.number: Separation of class 2.1.1 liquefiable gases: cylinders
sections.title: Separation of class 2.1.1 liquefiable gases: cylinders

items.action: Determine which subclause(s) (if any) of regulation 11.20 apply to the hazardous substance location
items.records: A record of the determination and the quantities of class 2.1.1 liquefiable gas present

items.action: Verify that the separation distances are met
items.records: A record of the basis for the verification

items.action: Verify that if the cylinders contain up to 100 kg, the requirements relating to the proximity of buildings and openings are met
items.records: A record of the basis for the verification

items.action: Verify that the cylinders are not located within 1 m of an opening to a drain
items.records: A record of the basis for the verification

items.action: Verify that if the cylinders contain more than 100 kg and up to 300 kg, the requirements relating to the proximity of buildings and openings are met
items.records: A record of the basis of the verification, including the nature of fire-resistant materials, separation distance, and openings

items.action: Verify that if the cylinders contain more than 300 kg and up to 1000 kg, the requirements relating to the proximity of buildings and openings are met and the wall of the building is vapour tight
items.records: A record of the basis of the verification, including the nature of the FRR materials, separation distance, and openings

sections.number: Separation of class 2.1.1 liquefiable gases: cylinder filling
sections.title: Separation of class 2.1.1 liquefiable gases: cylinder filling

items.action: Verify that the separation distances are met for the cylinder filling station
items.records: A record of the following: (a) the quantity of liquefiable gas at the hazardous substance location: (b) confirmation that the relevant minimum prescribed distance is met: (c) the point on the cylinder filling station that the separation distance is measure from

sections.title: Separation of class 2.1.2 aerosols

items.action: Establish the quantity of aerosols present and
items.records: A record of the quantities and separation distances

sections.title: Hazardous substance location holding not more than 10,000 L aggregate water capacity

items.records: Records of the building layout, building construction, FRR, and building elements including suppliers' tags for doors and windows

items.action: Verify that the general purpose warehouse used for receiving, storing, and distributing mixed goods (including flammable aerosols)— (a) is not a warehouse for the primary purpose of storing hazardous substances; and (b) is not accessible by the general public; and (c) has the flammable aerosols in the warehouse separated from the rest of the warehouse in accordance with the prescribed requirements and has prescribed fire protection
items.records: Records of the building layout, building construction, FRR, and building elements including suppliers' tags for doors and windows

sections.title: Hazardous substance location holding more than 10,000 L but not more than 100,000 L aggregate water capacity of flammable aerosols

items.records: A record confirming that the warehouse is a general purpose warehouse and is not accessible by the public Records of the building layout, building construction, FRR, building details, and fire protection A record of building details is to include a record of tags of the building elements

sections.number: Separation of class 3.1 substances: transfer points to protected places
sections.title: Separation of class 3.1 substances: transfer points to protected places

items.action: Verify that the separation distance to a protected place is met
items.records: A record that includes— (a) the substances contained; and (b) confirmation that the prescribed separation distance is met; and (c) the type of transfer point

sections.number: Class 3.1 substances to be held in buildings of a certain type
sections.title: Class 3.1 substances to be held in buildings of a certain type

sections.number: Storage Cabinet
sections.title: Storage Cabinet

items.action: Verify— (a) the quantity of substances and their hazard classifications; and (b) the standard to which the cabinet is constructed; and (c) where more than one cabinet is located within a building, the aggregate capacity of the cabinets and the separation of the cabinets; and (d) for AS 1940 cabinets, the exclusion of sources of ignition around the cabinet
items.records: A record of— (a) the plate on the cabinet or the standard the cabinet is constructed to; and (b) the location of the cabinet; and (c) the separation distance between the cabinets (if applicable); and (d) exclusion of ignition sources

sections.number: Building types A, B, C, and D storage
sections.title: Building types A, B, C, and D storage

items.action: Verify— (a) the building type; and (b) compliance with the building type in all aspects i.e. walls, roof, doors, and windows; and (c) the classification of the substance; and (d) the package sizes; and (e) the prescribed separation distances; and (f) the actual separation distances
items.records: A record of— (a) the quantity and hazard classes of the substances stored; and (b) the building type; and (c) the details of the FRR building elements, including suppliers' tags for doors and windows; and (d) the actual separation distances

sections.number: Storage of packages holding up to 60 litres of class 3.1 substances: separation from protected place
sections.title: Storage of packages holding up to 60 litres of class 3.1 substances: separation from protected place

items.action: Verify that the separation distance to a protected place is met
items.records: A record that includes— (a) the substances contained; and (b) confirmation that the prescribed separation distance is met

sections.title: Storage of packages holding class 3.1 substances in stores inside buildings

items.records: A record of the determination and the quantities of class 3 substances present

items.action: Verify— (a) that the stored substances are within the prescribed maximum; and (b) the construction details of the building, including details of the walls, ceiling, and doors; and (c) the prescribed quantity and package size limitations; and (d) if applicable, the requirements for when a door is opening into a building
items.records: A record of— (a) the quantity of flammable substances; and (b) the FRR elements, including suppliers' tags for doors and windows; and (c) details of compliance with prescribed requirements for a door opening into a building

items.action: Verify— (a) that the stored substances are within the prescribed maximum; and (b) the construction details of the building including details of the walls, ceiling, and doors; and (c) the prescribed quantity and package size limitations; and (d) if applicable, the requirements for when a door is opening into a building
items.records: A record of— (a) the quantity of flammable substances; and (b) the FRR elements, including suppliers' tags for doors and windows; and (c) details of compliance with prescribed requirements for a door opening into a building

items.action: Verify— (a) that the stored substances are within the prescribed maximum; and (b) the construction details of the building including details of the walls, ceiling, and doors; and (c) the prescribed quantity and package size limitations; and (d) if applicable, the requirements for when a door is opening into a building
items.records: A record of— (a) the quantity of flammable substances; and (b) the FRR elements, including suppliers' tags for doors and windows; and (c) details of compliance with prescribed requirements for a door opening into a building

sections.number: Type D storage with more than two walls in common with another building
sections.title: Type D storage with more than two walls in common with another building

items.action: Verify— (a) that the stored substances are within the prescribed maximum; and (b) the construction details of the building including details of the walls, ceiling, and doors; and (c) the prescribed quantity and package size limitations
items.records: A record of— (a) the quantity of flammable substances and package sizes; and (b) the FRR elements, including suppliers' tags for doors and windows

sections.number: Storage of packages holding more than 60 litres of class 3.1 substances: separation from protected place
sections.title: Storage of packages holding more than 60 litres of class 3.1 substances: separation from protected place

items.action: Verify that the separation distance to a protected place is met
items.records: A record that includes— (a) the substances contained; and (b) confirmation that the prescribed separation distance is met

sections.number: Class 3.1 substances used or in open packages or containers to be held in buildings of a certain type
sections.title: Class 3.1 substances used or in open packages or containers to be held in buildings of a certain type

items.action: Verify the building type and the construction details of the building Determine which regulations apply
items.records: A record of— (a) the building FRR details including suppliers' tags for doors and windows; or (b) details of compliance with AS/NZS 4114.1:2003 e.g. a record of the plate or the supplier's verification

sections.number: Type 1 workroom or a paint mixing room
sections.title: Type 1 workroom or a paint mixing room

items.action: Verify— (a) that the workroom/paint mixing room holds no more than the prescribed quantity or container size; and (b) the location of the building
items.records: A record of container sizes, aggregate quantities, and the location of the building

sections.number: Type 2 or Type 3 workroom
sections.title: Type 2 or Type 3 workroom

items.action: Verify that the building holds no more than the prescribed quantity
items.records: A record of hazardous substance classes and aggregate quantities

items.action: Verify that the separation distances meet or exceed the prescribed separation distances
items.records: A record of the actual and prescribed separation distances

sections.number: Other building type - regulation 11.37(5)
sections.title: Other building type - regulation 11.37(5)

items.action: Verify— (a) the quantity of hazardous substances; and (b) that the quantity of class 3.1 substances is not more than the specified maximum; and (c) the occupancy of the building; and (d) the construction details of that part of the building; and (e) the controls on prohibiting ignition sources
items.records: A record of— (a) the quantities; and (b) the building details in the vicinity of the flammable substances; and (c) the occupational details of the building

sections.number: Storage of packages holding class 3.1A, 3.1B, or 3.1C substances in retail stores
sections.title: Storage of packages holding class 3.1A, 3.1B, or 3.1C substances in retail stores

items.records: A record of the business type and container details

items.action: Verify that the quantities of class 3.1 substances are not more than the maximum
items.records: A record of the quantities

items.action: Verify that requirements for separation are compliant
items.records: A record of the separation details

items.records: A record of the building elements

items.action: Verify that the building is compliant
items.records: A record of the separation distances Where there is an intervening wall, a record of the FRR elements of the wall

sections.title: Indoor storage or use of LPG, propane, butane, or isobutane

items.action: Verify that the quantities of LPG, propane, butane, or isobutane are not more than the maximum
items.records: A record of the quantities
